fields.description: The dashboard this prompt was asked on. Its panel list, `source` tables and `skill` playbook are what scoped the loop's prompt.
fields.label: Dashboard

fields.description: Every action the loop took, in order: the JSON envelope the model emitted, and the bounded observation handed back. The prompt each step saw is reconstructable from this plus the dashboard; the SQL each `ask_data` ran is on its own `Nakhoda Agent Run` child.
fields.label: Steps

fields.description: How many actions the loop took before terminating. Bounded by `agent/thread.py:MAX_STEPS`.
fields.label: Step Count

fields.description: Markdown, when the loop chose `write_report`. `chart://<agent run>` references are resolved at read time by re-running that run's stored pipeline, so a report re-checks permissions rather than embedding a snapshot.
fields.label: Report

fields.description: The `DashboardPatch` ops the loop proposed. Validated and diffed, never applied - applying is a separate, user-approved call to `apply_dashboard_patch`.
fields.label: Patch Ops

fields.description: The `{i, title, state, field}` preview the approval screen renders for `patch_ops`.
fields.label: Patch Diff

fields.description: Set only once a user approved this turn's patch - the version `revert_dashboard_patch` undoes. Empty on a turn whose proposal was never applied.
fields.label: Applied Version

fields.description: `budget` means the step or data-step ceiling was reached with whatever was learned returned - never a silent truncation.
fields.label: Status
